# MemoryWorks

> MemoryWorks is the memory layer for engineering organizations. It turns company sources (GitHub, Slack, uploaded documents, web pages) into scoped, source-backed memory: decisions, policies, incidents, owners, and dependencies. It briefs people and AI agents with cited context before they change something, and records what happened afterwards.

Every company answer carries its evidence or abstains. Consequential actions (memory changes, plans, connector writes) wait for a person to approve them.

## Connect an agent

- MCP server (streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in): https://mcp.memoryworks.app/mcp
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http memoryworks https://mcp.memoryworks.app/mcp`
- Main tools: `get_orgmemory_briefing` (cited briefing before a change), `record_orgmemory_outcome` (what happened), `orgmemory_ask`, `orgmemory_search_memories`
